<h3><i class="bi bi-mortarboard" aria-hidden="true"></i> Scientific Background</h3>

My academic training spans biotechnology,
bioinformatics and systems biology. During
my PhD, I developed computational methods
to investigate biological complexity, focusing
on protein interaction networks, functional
annotations and the interpretation of omics
data. This background provided the methodological
foundation for my subsequent research in
animal genetics and genomics.


:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.home-intro-card}

<h3><i class="bi bi-diagram-3" aria-hidden="true"></i> Research Approach</h3>

My research integrates genomic, metabolomic
and phenotypic data to investigate the genetic
architecture of complex traits and molecular
phenotypes in animals. Depending on the research
question, I develop computational methods,
implement bioinformatic workflows or apply
statistical and machine learning approaches
to analyse high-dimensional biological datasets.

:::
:::

:::


## Research Areas

Exploring animal genomes, molecular phenotypes and biological diversity through genomic, multi-omics and computational approaches.

::: {.research-grid}

::: {.research-card}

<h3>
  <a href="research.html#genomics-molecular-phenotypes">
    <i class="bi bi-diagram-3" aria-hidden="true"></i>
    Genomics &amp; Molecular Phenotypes
  </a>
</h3>

Investigating the genetic architecture of intermediate phenotypes through genome-wide association studies and the integration of genomic, metabolomic, haematological and biochemical data.
:::

::: {.research-card}


<h3>
  <a href="research.html#metabolomics-phenomics-machine-learning">
    <i class="bi bi-graph-up" aria-hidden="true"></i>
    Metabolomics, Phenomics &amp; Machine Learning
  </a>
</h3>

Exploring molecular phenotypes, metabolic biomarkers and physiological variability using high-throughput metabolomics, computational methods and machine learning.
:::

::: {.research-card}


<h3>
  <a href="research.html#genomics-complex-production-traits">
    <i class="bi bi-bullseye" aria-hidden="true"></i>
    Genomics of Complex &amp; Production Traits
  </a>
</h3>

Dissecting the genetic basis of complex traits affecting animal production, morphology, performance and product quality in livestock and aquaculture species.
:::

::: {.research-card}


<h3>
  <a href="research.html#population-genomics-biodiversity">
    <i class="bi bi-globe-europe-africa" aria-hidden="true"></i>
    Population Genomics &amp; Biodiversity
  </a>
</h3>

Investigating genetic diversity, population structure, signatures of selection and evolutionary processes to support the characterization and conservation of animal genetic resources.
:::

::: {.research-card}


<h3>
  <a href="research.html#environmental-dna-metagenomics-one-health">
    <i class="bi bi-virus" aria-hidden="true"></i>
    Environmental DNA, Metagenomics &amp; One Health
  </a>
</h3>

Applying environmental DNA and metagenomic approaches to biodiversity monitoring, pathogen and virome characterization, and DNA-based food authentication.
:::

::: {.research-card}


<h3>
  <a href="research.html#bioinformatics-systems-biology">
    <i class="bi bi-puzzle" aria-hidden="true"></i>
    Bioinformatics, Systems Biology &amp; Genome Interpretation
  </a>
</h3>

Developing and applying computational approaches for biological network analysis, functional enrichment, genome interpretation and genetic variant prioritization.
:::

:::


## Selected Publications

Three representative publications from different
areas of my research.

::: {.publication-list}

**Bovo S. et al. (2025)**  
[Merging metabolomics and genomics provides a catalog of genetic factors that influence molecular phenotypes in pigs linking relevant metabolic pathways](https://doi.org/10.1186/s12711-025-00960-8)  
*Genetics Selection Evolution*, 57, 11.

**Bovo S. et al. (2020)**  
[Whole-genome sequencing of European autochthonous and commercial pig breeds allows the detection of signatures of selection for adaptation of genetic resources to different breeding and production systems](https://doi.org/10.1186/s12711-020-00553-7)  
*Genetics Selection Evolution*, 52, 33.

**Bovo S. et al. (2018)**  
[Shotgun metagenomics of honey DNA: Evaluation of a methodological approach to describe a multi-kingdom honey bee derived environmental DNA signature](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0205575)  
*PLOS ONE*, 13(10), e0205575.

:::
